reason: A Windows desktop and web UI enhancement plugin that creates a shortcut for launching the local dsh web interface and adds a draggable refresh control.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面创建可配置的 Windows 桌面快捷方式，并添加可拖动的刷新按钮。
summaries.en: Creates a configurable Windows desktop shortcut for the DeepSeek Harness web interface and adds a draggable refresh button.

capabilities: Launches the local dsh web interface in a configured browser
Adds a draggable refresh control to the web UI
Allows configuration of shortcut name, icon, browser, and launch arguments
